competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 20% chance and disturb its HP recovery for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.
Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times. Each hit inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns with an 80% chance and prevents the enemy from removing harmful effects for 2 turns with an 80% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 to 4 times to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns. Increases your Attack Bar by 10% in proportion to the number of Continuous Damage inflicted by this attack.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: Proportion to the number of Continuous DMG inflicted by this attack
